tasks.title: Add color animation to Mini Calculator title
tasks.description: Add CSS color animation to the h1 title element in src/App.css. Read the file to see the existing typewriter and blinkCursor animations (lines 91-107, 109-121). Create a new @keyframes rule for color animation that cycles through multiple colors. Update the h1 animation property (line 118) to include the new color animation alongside the existing typewriter and blinkCursor animations. The color animation should work in both light and dark themes by using appropriate color values. Ensure the animation is smooth and visually appealing.
acceptance_criteria: New @keyframes rule for color animation is added
h1 animation property includes typewriter, blinkCursor, and color animation
Color animation works in both light and dark themes
Animation is smooth and does not interfere with typewriter effect
